newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croat held for murder of Catholic nun in Bosnia.
newsitem.headline: Croat held for murder of Catholic nun in Bosnia.

text.p: A Bosnian Croat man has been arrested in connection with the stabbing death of a Croat Roman Catholic nun in central Bosnia, media rpeorted on Wednesday.
The Bosnian Croat news agency Habena identified the man as a Croat born in 1957 and said he was taken into custody in Vitez, a Croat-controlled municipality in central Bosnia.
It said the suspect had confessed to the Monday night killing of the nun near the parish church in Kakanj, 50 km (30 miles) north of Sarajevo and not far from Vitez.
United Nations police monitors said the 46-year-old nun, Danka Jurcevic who belonged to the Order of the Daughters of God's Love, was stabbed six times.
